Coding Agents & Assistants

Overview

Claude Code shipped a new stable version that adds model‑selection controls and idle‑compaction toggles, while OpenAI Codex users are seeing desktop‑client 404 errors and lost browser access. Kilo Code’s JetBrains plugin gained mobile‑agent listing and CLI bundling, OpenCode refined model‑reasoning handling and fixed upgrade paths, and Oh My Pi updated its agent‑core and AI layers. Cline introduced Cloud sessions, moved plugins to worker/sandbox threads, and retried provider failures, DeepSeek Harness released an alpha that polished skill lists and added model‑label slots, and Hermes Agent dealt with a provider‑override bug and reported Android/Termux regressions. Community highlights include official Claude Code plugins, a Codex‑focused tutorial, a Pi desktop wrapper, and a DeepSeek Harness desktop client.

Claude Code

  • Release: v2.1.302 adds the CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL environment variable to choose the model for the client‑side auto‑mode classifier, introduces an idle‑compaction toggle in /config with notices showing how to disable it, and adds notices to /design-sync and /design-login. [Release]
  • Hot issues: Users ask for a less intrusive end‑of‑turn “next‑step” box in the Code tab (#102273) and want the “Group by folder” toggle and always‑visible context percentage restored (#102305). [#102273] [#102305]
  • News: The official plugin directory (anthropics/claude-plugins-official) and the community‑curated awesome-claude-code list showcase growing plugin ecosystems for Claude Code. [claude-plugins-official] [awesome-claude-code]

OpenAI Codex

  • Hot issues: #54197 reports a 404 “Model not found” error on desktop clients because the client sends model “gpt-6”, while mobile works; #54376 describes the Codex app losing browser access after an update on macOS. [#54197] [#54376]
  • News: The tutorial repo tradecatlabs/vibe-coding-cn provides a Chinese‑language guide to Codex‑based pair programming, covering prompts, skills, workflow and context management. [vibe-coding-cn]

Kilo Code

  • Release: JetBrains plugin v7.1.11 adds listing remote agents for the mobile app, bundles Kilo CLI v7.8.13, and fixes UI‑thread blocking from ignore‑file loading, deferred prompt dispatch, worker console writes, MCP OAuth token refresh, session timing, and OpenRouter reasoning persistence. [jetbrains/v7.1.11]

OpenCode

  • Release: v1.19.3 lets users configure model reasoning options to generate reasoning variants, superseding catalog variants while preserving overrides; v1.19.2 ensures 1.x updates stay on the 1.x line, separates 2.x upgrades, and fixes Yarn and Homebrew upgrade handling. [v1.19.3] [v1.19.2]
  • Hot issues: #55607 (closed) reported frequent “Endpoint not available” errors with the free LongCat 2.5 preview, hinting at server capacity limits; #56033 (open) complains that the recent v2.0.29 update reduced communication and thought output, making the agent less informative. [#55607] [#56033]

Pi

  • News: vastsa/PI-Desktop packages the Pi Agent Harness into a local‑first desktop client built with Electron and Rust, supporting user‑installable plugins. [PI-Desktop]

Oh My Pi

  • Release: v18.11.3 adds queue‑aware prepareQueuedMessages and fixes JSON Schema dereferencing; v18.11.2 makes agent_start carry resumed tool‑call IDs and changes cancelled ask handling to report user‑canceled instead of retrying. [v18.11.3] [v18.11.2]

Cline

  • Release: v4.1.25 introduces Cline Cloud sessions (hosted GitHub sandbox tasks) and sets Gemini 4 Argon as the default provider when no model is selected; SDK v0.0.94 moves plugins to worker or sandbox threads, dropping in‑process mode; desktop v0.0.47 restores marketplace plugin loading, removes the Cloud sessions toggle (always on when available) and adds up‑to‑three retries on provider errors; cli v3.0.72 runs plugins in a worker thread and reports missing‑plugin situations. [v4.1.25] [sdk/v0.0.94] [desktop-v0.0.47] [cli-v3.0.72]

DeepSeek Harness

  • Prerelease: dsh‑v0.2.1‑alpha.5 fixes the skill list not updating after plugin toggles, reduces redundant terminal queries, improves PTC Mode guidance, stops Page Up from shifting the UI, and adds a conversation.input.model.label slot for plugins to customize model labels per provider. [dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.5]
  • News: dataelement/dsh-desktop delivers a dedicated DeepSeek Harness desktop client, wrapping the harness in an Electron‑style interface for local use. [dsh-desktop]

Hermes Agent

  • Hot issues: #138843 (closed) showed that a local session.create with an explicit provider but no base_url would reuse the profile’s stale base_url, causing 401 errors; #140004 (open) describes Hermes on Android/Termux losing functionality after several days, noting what works and what broke after recent updates. [#138843] [#140004]

The project claims a 98% reduction in sandbox tool output, persistent session memory, and cross‑platform routing via MCP and hooks. This attention signals growing interest in tools that manage agent context and sandbox overhead.

🕵️ Stealth Models on OpenRouter

No stealth models listed on OpenRouter today.

Coding Agents & Assistants

Overview

Claude Code shipped a stable update adding usage‑limit controls, OpenTelemetry tracing guidance, and a vim motion, while users reported UI regressions such as the missing “Group by” option and forced‑hidden Routines sidebar. Kilo Code, OpenCode, Pi, Oh My Pi, and Cline all released new stable versions with features like gateway routing, upgrade‑policy fixes, session‑share destination selection, tokenizer improvements, and cloud‑session rollout. DeepSeek Harness issued an alpha prerelease with custom model‑reasoning UI and plugin‑index support, and Hermes Agent faces an open bug where a local session provider override incorrectly reuses a profile’s base URL. News highlighted the growing ecosystem around agent skills, with the scientific‑agent‑skills library trending and gaining traction across Claude Code, Codex, and other agents.

Claude Code

  • Release: v2.1.301 adds CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS to cap unattended retries, OpenTelemetry tracing guidance for the claude-api skill, and the % vim motion to jump to matching brackets. https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.301
  • Hot issue: Windows users report the “Group by” option removed from the Code tab sidebar, leaving sessions grouped only by environment. https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/102088
  • News: The scientific‑agent‑skills library (177 validated skills, 100+ scientific databases) is compatible with Claude Code and is gaining traction on GitHub Trending. https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills

OpenAI Codex

  • News: The scientific‑agent‑skills library, which bills itself as the #1 Agent Skills library for science, lists Codex among its supported agents and has surged in popularity on GitHub Trending. https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills

Kilo Code

  • Release: v7.8.12 routes Kilo Gateway traffic through https://ai-gateway.kilo.ai/api/v1 by default (configurable via KILO_AI_GATEWAY_URL), while the JetBrains v7.1.10 release adds agent‑model editing, transcript preview with live updates, and CLI‑session forking. https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.12

OpenCode

  • Release: v1.19.2/1.19.1 locks updates to the 1.x line, improves upgrade handling for Yarn and Homebrew installs, and discontinues session sharing (existing share links no longer work). https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v1.19.2
  • Hot issue: Closed reports describe the free tier being unusable after reinstall (“Endpoint not available” on ~50 % of requests) and the free model limited to OpenCode‑only usage. https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/55443

Pi

  • Release: v1.3.0 introduces a sessionShareDestination setting (auto, gist, or radius) to choose where /share uploads go. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/releases/tag/v1.3.0

Oh My Pi

  • Release: v18.11.1 adds Tokenizer.countLatestTurn to count the latest assistant turn and Agent.prioritizeSteering to bring pending steering messages ahead of older ones. https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/releases/tag/v18.11.1

Cline

  • Release: v4.1.25 rolls out Cline Cloud sessions (hosted sandbox tasks), makes Gemini 4 Argon the default provider when no model is chosen, enforces plugin execution in workers or sandboxes, restores Marketplace plugin loading, removes the Cloud sessions toggle, and adds mid‑stream retry logic (up to 3 attempts). https://github.com/cline/cline/releases/tag/v4.1.25

DeepSeek Harness

  • Prerelease: dsh‑v0.2.1‑alpha.4 adds UI‑based reasoning‑level configuration for custom API models, enables discovering/installing plugins from custom plugin‑index sources, fixes input glitches between commands and arguments, improves Office file delivery, and reduces Linux startup checks. https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.4

Hermes Agent

  • Hot issue: An open bug shows that a local session.create with an explicit provider but no base_url incorrectly reuses the profile’s stale model.base_url, sending the new provider’s key to the old endpoint and resulting in 401 errors. https://github.com/nousresearch/hermes-agent/issues/138843

Quiet today: Gemini CLI, jcode, Command Code

Agent Tooling

Overview

Today, context-mode appeared on GitHub Trending, drawing significant attention for its context‑window optimizations aimed at AI coding agents. The project highlighted a 98% reduction in sandbox tool output, persistent session memory, and cross‑platform routing via MCP + hooks. No new stable releases or prereleases were issued, and no hot issues were reported. The surge in stars reflects growing interest in its approach to managing agent context.

context-mode

  • News: The project trended on GitHub, showcasing context‑window optimization for AI coding agents that cuts sandbox tool output by 98%, persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks (https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode).

Quiet today: OpenShell, herdr, Agent Deck
